segments.text: The court was silent, the prosecutor rose and began to lay out the details of the case,
The defendant was at the scene on the day of the crime
This is definite from the testimony of several witnesses
The defense attorney rose and argued back
What seems apparent is not always the truth
We have new evidence that will prove the defendants alibi
On the witness stand, a young woman was trembling
She was the person who had provided several clues to the police
That night I saw the defendant run from the scene
She answered in a voice close to a whisper
It was still too early for the judge to hand down his judgment
Weeks later, the jury reached a verdict, guilty
The defendant was sent to jail
But the attorney decided to appeal
Law must be strict, but it must not lose room for mercy
The pursuit of justice is always also a confrontation
With the limits of human judgement
